generation.scope: A rank-three symmetric kernel on a finite point graph forces either a bisymmetric window or exponential growth. In the full case a rank-two commutator with a cyclic operator determines the symmetric pairing even at repeated eigenvalues. In the deficient case binary septics produce exponentially many independent paths. At opposite rank nine with a simple local point the existence of a ternary middle support is now necessary and sufficient for regularity.

open_mathematics: Treat finite graphs without a simple local point, higher opposite ranks, positive-dimensional fibers, and the remaining moduli components and specializations.
